subject: Post-demo recap: decision path, stakeholders, and scope confirmation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@lumipay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: decision path, stakeholders, and scope confirmation

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all have the same picture.

Summary from the call:
- Primary use: low-latency invoice summarization and sensitive-field redaction inside Lumipay’s merchant admin UI.
- Expected monthly token volume: ~45M tokens after Q1 ramp.
- Decision horizon: procurement + legal review this quarter; go/no-go by end of Sep.

Open items we discussed (action owners in parentheses):
1) Economic buyer — you mentioned Rajiv (confirm email below). If that’s correct, we’ll route the commercial proposal and pricing tiers to him (Emma).
2) Security questionnaire — Monica will send our standard intake and a filled example (Monica).
3) Systems in scope — you said production API, merchant analytics DB, and S3 artifacts. Please confirm exactly which environments (prod, staging) need data-access detail (Emma).
4) Procurement timing & PO process — Rishi to coordinate once we have initial security answers (Rishi).

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll attach a short kickoff packet and our standard security questionnaire (see attachments).
- Emma / Rajiv: please confirm procurement contact and whether Lumipay requires an NDA before we circulate the questionnaire.
- Emma: can you confirm the list of systems in scope by Tuesday (24 Aug)?

If that works I’ll loop in our legal for any NDAs and schedule a 30-minute security kickoff next week.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@lumipay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@lumipay.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: decision path, stakeholders, and scope confirmation

Thanks Marcus — great demo and clear recap. Quick answers:

- Confirmed economic buyer: Rajiv Shah (copied). He owns final sign-off on spend.
- Procurement contact: Ilya Petrov (procurement@lumipay.com) — they prefer a PO and our standard vendor packet; usually 3 weeks lead time.
- NDA: Not required up front for the questionnaire; we’ll share any sensitive docs after the security kickoff.
- Systems in scope (initial): production API (api.lumipay.com), merchant_analytics cluster (AWS account 987654321), and S3 bucket lumipay-merchant-exports (prod). Staging is out of scope for now.

I’ll also take a glance at the questionnaire and flag anything that needs clarification. Can we target Aug 28 for the security kickoff?

—Emma
Product Security Manager
Lumipay
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@lumipay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Lumipay security questionnaire and intake packet (attached)

Hi Emma / Rajiv — attaching our standard security intake (Lumipay_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and a brief kickoff pack that explains what we need for each section. Highlights:

- Section A (Company controls): please confirm SOC 2 status and point us to the report if available.
- Section B (Data flows): we need a simple diagram and an answer on whether PII is stored in merchant_analytics. If PII is present, specify fields.
- Section C (Access & keys): list any cross-account roles or third-party data processors.

Monica note: we default to an architecture that minimizes copy of PII — if you flag fields we can propose redaction or tokenization patterns.

Attachments: Lumipay_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — please fill tabs A–C and return. Also included: lumipay-prod-network-diagram.pdf (we’ll use this for the kickoff).

Next: once you return tab A–C we’ll schedule a 45-minute technical kickoff with our security engineer to validate scope. Proposed slots: Thu Aug 27 09:00–10:00 PT or Fri Aug 28 11:00–12:00 PT. What works better for your team?

Thanks,
Monica
Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@lumipay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Stone <emma.stone@lumipay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumipay security questionnaire and intake packet (attached)

Appreciate the clear pack Monica. A few clarifications from my side before we fill:

1) Commercial constraints: we may need a single-year committed tier vs monthly usage for Q4. Will need that call with Marcus.
2) Data residency: all merchant data must stay in us-east-1 — please confirm Redwood supports region pinning for dedicated/private options.
3) For SOC 2: Lumipay has an in-scope SOC 2 report dated Apr 2026; I’ll share the link with Monica directly.

Emma: planning to have procurement/Ilya involved once we land on the legal wording. We can likely return the questionnaire by Aug 27 EOD with the requested fields.

Rajiv
COO, Lumipay
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@lumipay.com>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@lumipay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: decision path, stakeholders, and scope confirmation

Great — thanks for the quick replies. Two quick confirmations from our side:

- Region pinning: we do support pinning to us-east-1 for hosted dedicated deployments; Monica/engineering will confirm exact limits during the kickoff.
- Commercial model: I’ll propose a committed-Q4 tier and a catch-all overage rate in the initial commercial draft. Ilya/Procurement — if you’d like to share standard terms ahead of time, that will speed review.

I’ll send a calendar invite for the security kickoff on Fri Aug 28 11:00–11:45 PT and include a short agenda (scope review, data flow verification, next steps for SOC 2 evidence).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Marcus
